messages:
Eden: hey all, day 2 here. trying to finish dev boot on WSL2 + VSCode. running into node version conflicts (system node vs asdf), gpg signing not triggering in VSCode commits, and 1password op sessions not visible to docker tasks. any quick checklist?
Riley: welcome! quick wins: open the repo with Remote - WSL, ensure asdf is loaded early in your shell rc so shims come first.
Maya: for gpg: install gnupg inside WSL, import your key there and set `git config --global gpg.program /usr/bin/gpg`. pinentry-curses usually works for terminal prompts.
Eden: VSCode still shows unsigned in the UI though terminal shows signed.
Riley: VSCode source control spawns non-login shells. put gpg-agent config and pinentry settings in ~/.profile and reload gpg-agent. also try launching VSCode from WSL shell (`code .`).
Eden: thanks. op cli: `eval $(op signin)` works in my interactive shell but docker-compose run from VSCode tasks doesn't see REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Maya: use direnv with an .envrc that reads from op (e.g. `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(op read "op://Redwood/Dev/REDWOOD_API_KEY")`). direnv ensures environment for processes started by VSCode when opened from WSL.
InfraBot: Note: internal doc https://intranet/redwood/onboarding/dev-setup-wsl has scripts for op session refresh and sample .envrc.
Eden: one more: corporate cert causes docker pulls to fail inside WSL.
Riley: copy company CA into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates and run `sudo update-ca-certificates`, then restart Docker Desktop and confirm WSL integration enabled.
Eden: perfect. appreciate the help!
Maya: welcome aboard :heart:
